test_inputs.explanation: Values were taken from the encoded filter parameters in the agent's navigated URLs. The base_url is the site host used in every step. Two base64-encoded filter payloads were decoded: one contained firstname=Jane, lastname=Doe, email=jane.doe@example.com, type=c, last_url=/checkout/cart; the other contained customer_id[from]=100, customer_id[to]=100 and firstname set to the IP 203.0.113.45 (mapped here to ip_address). session/locale fields (en_US) and the form_key were observed but are not part of the tool schema, so session/date fields are left empty.
